name: albania-vat
description: Albanian VAT (TVSH, tatimi mbi vlerën e shtuar) for tax year 2026 under Law No. 92/2014 as amended to Law No. 80/2025, Council of Ministers Decision No. 953/2014 and Law No. 87/2019 on invoices and fiscalisation. Covers the 20% standard rate, the 6% and 10% reduced rates and what each covers, 0% exports and international transport, exempt supplies, the ALL 10,000,000 registration threshold, voluntary registration above ALL 5,000,000, notaries and bailiffs at zero threshold, monthly returns due 1
